extDescription.message: Send links to your rDownloader LinkGrabber from the context menu.

serverHint.message: Address of the rDownloader web interface, e.g. http://nas.local:8710. 127.0.0.1:8710 and localhost:8710 are built in; any other address asks for a permission.

tokenHint.message: Create it under System → Browser extension in the rDownloader web interface. It is shown only once.

permissionDenied.message: Permission for this server was not granted.

permissionDeniedLoopback.message: Permission for this address was not granted. Only 127.0.0.1:8710 and localhost:8710 are built in; any other port needs the permission.

serverInvalid.message: That is not a valid server address. For example: http://127.0.0.1:8710 or http://[::1]:8710.

notConfigured.message: Please configure server and token first.

errorUnauthorized.message: Token rejected — create a new capture token.

noPageUrl.message: The current tab has no web address.

clipboardNoLinks.message: No links found in the clipboard.

interceptFailed.message: Handover failed, the browser keeps the download: $1

interceptLegacyServer.message: This rDownloader is too old for download details — only the address was sent.

interceptServerUnreachable.message: rDownloader cannot be reached. The browser will handle this download.

interceptPostUnsupported.message: This download was started by a form and cannot be repeated. The browser will handle it.

interceptRequestUnknown.message: The request behind this download was not observed and cannot be repeated safely. The browser will handle it.

optionsInterceptHint.message: Downloads started in the browser are paused and handed to rDownloader. Requires a capture token.

menuSession.message: Share session for this site with rDownloader

sessionShared.message: Session for $HOST$ sent. Approve it in rDownloader to use it.

sessionEmpty.message: No cookies found for this site.

sessionUnconfigured.message: Pair the extension with rDownloader first.

captchaWaiting.message: A captcha for $HOST$ is waiting. Open the rDownloader extension to answer it in this browser.

captchaOpened.message: The hoster's page is opening. Solve the captcha there; rDownloader then reports what the server answered.

captchaPermissionDenied.message: Permission for $HOST$ was not granted, so the page cannot be opened.

captchaSent.message: rDownloader accepted the captcha answer for $HOST$.

captchaFailed.message: The captcha answer for $HOST$ could not be handed over: $REASON$

captchaGone.message: The captcha for $HOST$ is no longer waiting and its tab was closed. It was answered elsewhere or it expired.

captchaSkipFailed.message: rDownloader was not told that the captcha for $HOST$ was declined: $REASON$ The waiting download will now run into a timeout.

captchaListFailed.message: Waiting captchas could not be loaded: $REASON$

captchaNoWidget.message: No captcha appeared on $HOST$ – this browser is most likely signed in there already. The sign-in in rDownloader has stopped: hand this session over with “Take over from browser” at the account, or sign out of $HOST$ here and test the account again.

handoverNote.message: Only cookies of $HOST$ are sent, and only to your rDownloader. The browser asks for permission first.

handoverWaiting.message: rDownloader asks for your $HOST$ session (account “$ACCOUNT$”). Open the extension to hand it over or decline.

handoverDone.message: Your $HOST$ session was handed over to rDownloader.

handoverFailed.message: The $HOST$ session could not be handed over: $REASON$

handoverEmpty.message: This browser has no cookies for $HOST$. Sign in there first, then hand the session over.

handoverDenied.message: Without the browser’s permission for $HOST$, no cookie was read.

handoverDeclined.message: Declined: rDownloader knows the $HOST$ session will not be handed over.

handoverListFailed.message: Requested sessions could not be loaded: $REASON$

filesAllow.message: Hand NZB, torrent and ZIP files from $HOST$ to rDownloader

filesRevoke.message: Keep files from $HOST$ in the browser again

filesNote.message: rDownloader then takes what the browser received from $HOST$, or fetches it once with this site's cookies. The cookies are never stored. The browser asks for permission first.

filesAllowed.message: NZB, torrent and ZIP files from $HOST$ now go to rDownloader.

filesDenied.message: No permission for $HOST$ — its files stay in the browser.

filesRevoked.message: Files from $HOST$ stay in the browser again.

fileConsentIncomplete.message: Files from $HOST$ cannot be handed over: the browser no longer grants access. Allow the site again in the popup.

optionsFilesHint.message: NZB, torrent and ZIP downloads from these sites go to rDownloader instead of staying in the browser. Allow a site from the popup while you are on it.
